name: ivs-chat-message-review
description: Amazon IVS Chat message review handler: stateless moderation plus hand-off of allowed messages to SQS.

scripts.package: npm ci --omit=dev && rm -f function.zip && zip -qr function.zip src banned-words.json package.json node_modules
scripts.package:windows: npm ci --omit=dev && "%SystemRoot%\System32\tar.exe" -a -c -f function.zip src banned-words.json package.json node_modules
